assumptions: CLI `msssim` -> msssim_rgb8 (lib.rs:473) -> rgb_luma_inner (lib.rs:528): f32 luma 0.2989R+0.5870G+0.1140B (LUMA_COEF:129, unrounded MATLAB rgb2gray), then kernel run (kernel.rs:117-290).
Level count auto_level (lib.rs:133-141): min(5, floor(log2(min(w,h)/11))+1); 5 for all eval shapes >=256.

Per level (kernel.rs:135-260): fused horizontal 11-tap Gaussian producing FIVE product accumulators [r, d, r2, d2, rd] into an 11-row ring, then vertical 11-tap reduce of the 5 ring rows + per-window map (cs at levels 0..L-2, full ssim at last level). Ring buffer = the MATLAB imfilter boundary via wrapping row indices.
Horizontal per out-el: 11 taps x (2 ld + 3 mul for [r*r,d*d,r*d] + 5 fma) = 22 ld + 33 mul + 55 fma + 5 ring st.

Vertical per out-el: 11 taps x 5 ring loads x fma = 55 ld + 55 fma; map: s1sq/s2sq/s12 (2 mul+sub each = 6 ops), n1=2m1m2+c1 (mul+mul+add... counted), n2, d1, d2, s=(n1*n2)/(d1*d2), c=n2/d2 -> ~10 mul + 8 add + 2 div; 2 map stores + 2 f64 accumulate adds.
decimate (kernel.rs:43-56): 2x2 box *0.25 with edge clamp -> 3 add + 1 mul + 4 ld + 1 st per out el, applied to both images between levels (LV-1 times).
Final (kernel.rs:290): prod(mcs.^w)*mssim^w over 5 means — ~15 f64 flops once.
f64 mean accumulation folded into map stage (2 add per out el). Level dims use ceil-halving (w.div_ceil(2)).

stages.name: fused 11-tap Gaussian x 5 product accums -> ring
stages.notes: Per tap: r,d loads + r*r,d*d,r*d muls + 5 fma into accums. Runs on rows+10 wrapped rows (folded into elements).

stages.name: 11-tap vertical reduce of 5 ring rows + l/c/s map
stages.notes: 55 ring fma + sigma corrections (6) + n1/n2/d1/d2 (8) + s,c divs + 2 st + 2 f64 mean adds (folded in add).
